biggest_catch: Earnings are entirely variable - you earn only when your photos license through 500px's distribution partners; no guaranteed income.
catches: Free to contribute; you earn 60% of net sales on images submitted exclusively for licensing, 30% non-exclusive (Awesome/Pro memberships can earn 100% on exclusive)
Distribution partners (e.g. Getty Images, VCG) set their own pricing and may discount; your royalty is on net sales
Minimum US$30 balance to receive payment; payments in USD monthly
Your photos must pass 500px's licensing review (Accepted/Declined statuses)
Non-exclusive licensing means you can also sell the same images elsewhere
